recorded_from: huggingface_hub 1.33.0 (python/envs/cpu/uv.lock). hf_hub_download and then snapshot_download wrote an empty cache for a three-file repository (config.json, model.safetensors and layers/0/sae.safetensors), served by a local endpoint through HF_ENDPOINT. The paths below are that cache's files with the commit, the blob names and the repository folder replaced by placeholders.

placeholders.<commit>: the commit the revision resolves to
placeholders.<blob>: a blob name: a 40-hex git id, or a 64-hex SHA-256 for an LFS file
placeholders.<name>: a file name in the snapshot
placeholders.<nested>: a file name with folders in it, such as layers/0/sae.safetensors
placeholders.<up>: the ../ steps from the link's folder up to the repository folder: two for a file in the snapshot's top folder, and one more for each folder below it (four for layers/0/sae.safetensors). It follows from the file's path, so the same entry covers every depth
